{{Quote|When I was assigned to work on a prison barge for the Empire, we encountered this virus, or a close cousin, on what was believed to be an abandoned Star Destroyer. Apparently, the virus had wiped out the crew of the Destroyer. Once we sent a boarding party, it quickly wiped out most of the prison ship.|[[Zahara Cody]]|<ref name="SWG:GI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Get Inoculated|Dathomir}}</ref>}}
The '''''Vector''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] in service prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==History==
[[File:EssentialLegends-ZombieTroopers.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Vector'' was overrun by "the Sickness" (infected stormtroopers pictured).]]
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], under orders from [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], the ship and its crew arrived at the planet [[Meglumine]] to retrieve materials related to the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]]. They were to take the materials to a testing facility at the planet [[Khonji Seven]]. However, one of the tanks containing the virus breached as the ship traveled into the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], infecting the majority of the crew and mutating them into [[Zombie/Legends|mindless creatures]]. At least 46,700 [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] personnel, including 9,700 [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], had been traveling on board the ''Vector'', and almost all were killed by the virus. Thirty men, including [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gorrister]], sealed themselves off in one section of the ship and took refuge in the shuttle [[Freebird (Sentinel-class)|''Freebird'']].

Ten weeks later, the [[Prison ship/Legends|prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']] happened across the vessel, having suffered damage to its engines. A team from the barge, led by [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]] [[Jareth Sartoris]], boarded ''Vector'' to salvage components from the ship's engines. Within hours of the crew returning to ''Purge'', however, the majority of the barge's population also contracted the virus. With no chance of escape on the crippled barge, the survivors of the prison ship boarded ''Vector'' in an attempt to utilize it as an escape vessel. Of the six survivors who left the ''Purge'' and entered the Star Destroyer, four escaped.

==Behind the scenes==
''Vector'' is one of the primary settings of the novel ''[[Death Troopers]]'', written by [[Joe Schreiber]]. The ship is unnamed in the novel, but is named in the [[in-universe]] [[Stormtrooper TK 329 (TK329) on Twitter|Twitter account]] of an Imperial [[TK329|stormtrooper]] set up prior to the book's release, detailing his life on board the ''Vector'' prior to the events in the novel.

The name ''Vector'' is likely a reference to the epidemiology term meaning a carrier of pathogen.
